title: Variety records: roots and tubers (e.g. cassava, yam, potato, sweet potato) (open sources)
context: roots and tubers (e.g. cassava, yam, potato, sweet potato) are important crops with openly-documented varieties in gene banks and public catalogs.
objective: Compile documented variety records for roots and tubers (e.g. cassava, yam, potato, sweet potato) from open sources, following the schema with a citation and license per record.
acceptanceCriteria: >=15 records across >=2 roots and tubers (e.g. cassava, yam, potato, sweet potato), each with source + license
No proprietary catalogs or agronomic advice
